# MEMORY MODEL — Studio model/mesh editor ("modeldoc")

## 0. The five layers of truth, at a glance

| Layer | Owner | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| **Durable source soup** `g_source_verts` + face groups/materials/part ranges/colors | `framework/gpu/model_source.zig:19-36` | until next `retain()` / process exit |
| **Displayed edit mesh** `g_edit_verts`/`g_edit_key`/`g_edit_count` | `framework/gpu/3d.zig:559-563` | until next `setPaintTarget` / process exit |
| **Indexed topology cache** `g_indexed_edit_mesh` | `framework/gpu/3d.zig:572` | invalidated by metadata/UV mismatch |
| **Welded selection topology** (`g_verts`, `g_corner_vert`, `g_edges`, selection masks) | `framework/gpu/mesh_edit.zig:290-350` | lazily rebuilt, `reset()` on every topology change |
| **Paint atlas + island layout** `g_rgba`, `g_layout`, `g_positions` | `framework/gpu/model_paint.zig:33-87` | rebuilt per layout revision |

Everything is `std.heap.c_allocator` slices + `std.ArrayListUnmanaged`. **No arena anywhere** in this subsystem (`3d.zig:8489` is a comment about a GPU bump region, not an allocator). `hotstate` uses `page_allocator` (`framework/state/hotstate.zig:18`).

---

## 1. Where the editable mesh document lives in Zig

There is no single `ModelDoc` struct — the document is a **set of parallel module-global slices**, keyed by face index, split across three files.

### 1a. Authoritative source (`framework/gpu/model_source.zig`)
```zig
:19  var g_source_verts: ?[]f32 = null;      // interleaved 8 f32/vert, full-res source
:22  var g_source_colors: ?[]u8 = null;      // source facecount*4 rgba
:23  var g_face_to_source: ?[]u32 = null;    // displayed face -> source face
:26  var g_source_face_group: ?[]u32 = null; // one authored-n-gon id per SOURCE face
:30  var g_source_face_material: ?[]u32 = null;
:36  var g_part_ranges: ?[]u32 = null;       // flattened [lo,hi) pairs, one per Outliner PART
```
`retain()` (`model_source.zig:39`) `clear()`s then `alloc.dupe`s — a **full copy per load/topology replace**. `clear()` (`:63`) frees each slice individually.

### 1b. Displayed/render mesh (`framework/gpu/3d.zig:559-579`)
```zig
:559 var g_edit_key_hash: u64 = 0;
:560 var g_edit_key: ?[]u8 = null;
:561 var g_edit_verts: ?[]f32 = null;   // active displayed mesh, interleaved 8 f32/vert
:562 var g_edit_count: u32 = 0;
:563 var g_edit_revision: u32 = 0;      // the re-key counter
:572 var g_indexed_edit_mesh: ?indexed_edit_mesh.Mesh = null;
```
Hidden parts are stashed out of the live mesh entirely: `HiddenGroup` (`3d.zig:3367-3376`) in `var g_hidden_groups: std.ArrayListUnmanaged(HiddenGroup)` (`3d.zig:3377`) — hide moves triangles into host-side slices, show re-appends them.

### 1c. Indexed edit topology (`framework/gpu/indexed_edit_mesh.zig`)
The only genuinely *structured* representation, and it is a cache, not the truth:
```zig
:151 pub const Mesh = struct {
:153     vertices: std.ArrayListUnmanaged(Vertex) = .empty,
:154     faces: std.ArrayListUnmanaged(Face) = .empty,
:159     render_triangles: std.ArrayListUnmanaged([3]u32) = .empty,
:163     render_uvs: std.ArrayListUnmanaged([3]Vec2) = .empty,
```
`Face` (`:66-88`) owns `vertices`, `uvs`, `source_triangles` ArrayLists + `group`/`part`/`material` + a `diagonal`. Deletion is **tombstoned**, not compacted (`Vertex.alive`, `Face.alive`). Weld epsilon is a durability contract: `IMPORT_WELD_EPS = 1/1024` (`:18`).

### 1d. Selection/weld topology (`framework/gpu/mesh_edit.zig:287-360`)
Derived-only, rebuilt lazily against `g_built_for` (`:290`). `reset()` (`:925-963`) frees all 17 slices and zeroes `g_built_for`.

### 1e. On-the-wire snapshot type
`meshdoc_format.Snapshot` (`framework/gpu/meshdoc_format.zig:35-47`) — a transient, allocator-owned composition of `FaceBlock`s (visible block + every hidden part block), built only for the RJMD write.

---

## 2. Mutate-in-place vs rebuild-and-swap

**Two sharply different paths**, chosen by whether the op changes triangle count/ownership.

### 2a. IN-PLACE — position-only edits (gizmo move/scale/rotate, nudge, mirror)
`mesh_edit.applyTransform` writes welded `g_verts`, then scatters into `model_paint`'s `g_positions` in place:
```zig
mesh_edit.zig:2345-2348
    pos[dst + 0] = verts[src + 0];
    pos[dst + 1] = verts[src + 1];
    pos[dst + 2] = verts[src + 2];
```
Then `3d.zig:1104 applyMeshMutation` fans that out with **no reallocation and no re-key**:
- `copyPaintPositionsToEditVerts` (`3d.zig:683`) — writes `g_edit_verts` rows + recomputed normals
- `mesh.updatePositionsFromInterleaved` — patches the indexed cache
- `model_source.updateGeometryFromDisplayed` (`model_source.zig:250`) — writes back through the displayed→source map
- `patchActiveEditMesh` (`3d.zig:715`) — `@memcpy`s the changed band into the host stash **and** `stageVertexRows` into the retained GPU buffer at the existing offset (`3d.zig:741-750`)

Also in place: `flipSelectedTriangleWinding` swaps interleaved rows (`mesh_edit.zig:56-85`); paint writes straight into the atlas (`model_paint.zig:81-84`: *"The atlas IS the source of truth — a paint writes straight here (no separate per-face array, no full rebuild)"*).

### 2b. REBUILD-AND-SWAP — every topology op
`fn replaceActiveEditMesh(new_verts, count)` (`3d.zig:1041`) is the single funnel. 18 call sites: extrude face `:1439`, extrude edge `:1513`, create face `:1662`, delete selection `:2925`, add part `:3322-3326`, detach `:3550`, merge parts `:3614`, journal restore `:4223`, path array `:4643`, flip `:4845`, solidify `:5058`, split quads `:5279`.

Its sequence:
```zig
3d.zig:1061-1064
    const old_hash = g_edit_key_hash;
    g_edit_revision +%= 1;
    const key = std.fmt.allocPrint(..., "modelview-edit-{x}-{d}", .{ old_hash, g_edit_revision })
3d.zig:1080-1082
    paint_program.snapshotLayersForCarry();
    setPaintTarget(key, new_verts, count);
    model_source.retain(key, new_verts[0..need], count);
3d.zig:1088  if (!stashHostMesh(key, new_verts[0..need], count)) return false;
```
`setPaintTarget` (`3d.zig:1006`) does `clearActiveEditMesh()` → `paint_program.reset()` → `mesh_edit.reset()` → `model_paint.setTarget()` → `dupe` of the new verts. `model_paint.setTarget` (`model_paint.zig`) frees everything and calls `rebuildLayoutInner`, which **reallocates the whole atlas** (`@memset(rgba, 0)`).

A gentler variant exists: `replaceActiveEditMeshPreservingAtlas` (`3d.zig:1092`) — same re-key and same full soup swap, but reuses the atlas raster verbatim via `model_paint.setTargetPreservingAtlas` and does **not** advance `g_layout_revision`. Used by loop cut (`:2092`), indexed delete (`:2923`), indexed add-part (`:3322`), and journal restore (`:4221`).

### 2c. Undo — FULL SNAPSHOTS, not journal replay, not inverse ops
`JournalEntry` (`3d.zig:3680-3695`) is a deep copy of the whole document domain:
```zig
verts, count, groups, materials, part_ranges, colors,
hidden: []JournalHidden, atlas: ?JournalAtlas,
paint_state: ?*paint_program.JournalState, note, label
```
Bounded by `JOURNAL_CAP = 32` and `JOURNAL_BYTE_BUDGET: usize = 192 * 1024 * 1024` (`:3698-3699`), with a separate `JOURNAL_ATLAS_BYTE_CAP = 64 MiB` (`:3703`). Snapshot is taken **before** the op (`journalSnapshotCurrent`, `3d.zig:3814`), committed only on success (`journalCommit`, `:3915`), discarded on failure. Eviction is oldest-first by count AND bytes (`:3944-3948`).

`journalStep` (`3d.zig:4294`) is a **swap**: snapshot current → pop the top of one stack → `journalInstall` → push the snapshot onto the other stack.

Three restore domains (`mesh_journal_log.zig:255 restoreDomainForLabel`): `.mesh` → full `replaceActiveEditMesh`; `.uv` → `journalInstallUv` (`3d.zig:4152`) restores corner UVs only; `.atlas` → `journalInstallAtlas` (`3d.zig:4169`) reimports the whole RGBA.

### 2d. The one true replay journal: PAINT
Paint is the exception — it is a **replay-from-program** system, not a snapshot system:
> `paint_program.zig:14-16`: *"undo drops the last unit and RE-RUNS the program onto the atlas — the program is the truth, so undo is replay, never a pixel diff."*

`endStrokeUnit` (`paint_program.zig:1048`) appends `{layer, ops}` to `g_strokes`; `g_baseline` (`:118`) anchors the replay (`replayAll`, `:1435`). So: **mesh undo = snapshot restore; paint undo = program replay over a raster baseline.** They share one redo invalidation point (`3d.zig:7549 journalFreeStack(&g_journal_redo)`).

---

## 3. The re-key mechanism

**Issue site — exactly two, both bumping the same counter:**
- `3d.zig:1062-1064` (`replaceActiveEditMesh`)
- `3d.zig:1113-1115` (`replaceActiveEditMeshPreservingAtlas`)

Key format `modelview-edit-{old_hash}-{revision}`. `g_edit_key_hash = hashKey(key)` is FNV-1a (`3d.zig:10088`). A fresh model load instead keys on the **file path or package key** (`v8_bindings_core.zig:333`, `:479`).

**What invalidates a key:** any call into `setPaintTarget` — i.e. every topology op, every quality re-mesh (`setQualityPaintTarget`, `3d.zig:1012`), every mesh-domain undo/redo, and every fresh load.

**Consumers holding the key:**

| Consumer | Site | Effect of a re-key |
|---|---|---|
| GPU intern cache `g_geo_cache[]` (hash→offset/count) | `3d.zig:281-288`, `internGeometry:` | **new slot + new bytes appended**; the old slot is never evicted |
| Host mesh stash `g_host_stash[16]` | `3d.zig:359`; `stashHostMesh` evicts *every other* entry (`:384-390`) | old CPU copy freed |
| `model_paint` target `g_key_hash` | `model_paint.zig:32` | atlas rebuilt or adopted |
| JS `model.key` React state | `ModelView.tsx:827` | re-render |
| `<Scene3D.Mesh hostKey={model.key} />` | `ModelView.tsx:2808` | GPU draw resolves the new interned slice |
| Hot-reload DOC twig | `ModelView.tsx:1771` | re-stamped by an effect on `model?.key` |
| Pen/path-plane reset keys | `ModelView.tsx:2891, 2912, 2939` | overlay sessions reset |
| Draw-time paint-target match | `3d.zig:11283` | `if (model_paint.isTarget(key_hash) or (g_edit_key_hash != 0 and key_hash == g_edit_key_hash))` |

Note: `g_edit_revision` is **not** reset by `clearActiveEditMesh` (`3d.zig:704-713`), so keys are monotonic for the process.

---

## 4. Dual-representation sync (JS mirror ↔ Zig doc)

### What JS mirrors
1. **`model = {key, count, radius, name}`** — `ModelView.tsx` React state. Adopted via `adoptMesh` / `applyTopo` (`:930-968`).
2. **`partRangesRef.current: {lo,hi}[]`** — `ModelView.tsx:1108`, explicitly *"a MIRROR of the host's part-range truth (req_2644)"*. Re-read, never patched, by `resyncPartRanges` (`:1129-1152`) from `__mesh_part_ranges` (`v8_bindings_core.zig:1841`).
3. **`selInfo/selMode`** — `adoptHostSelection` (`:1175`) mirrors `__mesh_edit_counts`; host pushes via the `__meshEditSelChanged` global (`:2314`).
4. **Outliner rows `state.modelParts[modelId]`** in `AppFrame.tsx` — stamped by rank through the `__modelPartRangesChanged` global door (`AppFrame.tsx:4599-4631`).
5. **The journal note** — JS pushes outliner metadata *into* Zig: `__mesh_journal_note(JSON.stringify({modelId, parts}))` (`AppFrame.tsx:4451, 4723`) → `g_journal_note` (`3d.zig:3707`), which rides every snapshot so undo can resync the outliner.
6. **Semantic action events** — drained from the fixed `g_mesh_action_events[128]` ring (`3d.zig:3709`, `MESH_ACTION_CAP = 128`, `:3704`) and decoded by `cart/editor/model/nativeMeshEvents.ts`.
7. **Hot twigs** `editor:meshdoc:v1` / `editor:meshtool:v1` / `editor:isopose:v1`.

**Geometry never crosses the bridge in either direction after load** (`nativeMeshEvents.ts:2-3`; `meshDoc.ts:175-177`).

### Resync path
`__model_session_json` (`3d.zig:4120 modelSessionJson`, registered `v8_bindings_core.zig:3753`) returns `{key, count, radius, undo, redo, atlas, paintStale}`. `resumeHostSession` (`ModelView.tsx:2320-2366`):
```ts
:2322  const twig = getHotState<DocTwig|null>(DOC_TWIG_KEY, null);
:2323  if (!twig || twig.docId !== hotDocId) return false;
:2325  if (!session || session.key !== twig.key) return false;
:2326  setModel({ key: session.key, count: session.count, ... });
:2331  resyncPartRanges();
```
`syncRenderedNodeState` (`framework/v8_app.zig:3095`, called `:3216`) is the *reconciler's* per-node state sync, not modeldoc-specific.

### Documented drift points
- **Range-count mismatch is refused, not reconciled.** `__modelPartRangesChanged` bails when counts differ: `AppFrame.tsx:4607 if (rows.length === 0 || rows.length !== ranges.length) return prev;`
- **Resume HEAL**: a resumed host with *fewer* ranges than the doc declares re-seeds from disk — `ModelView.tsx:2338-2343`.
- **Save-time refusal**: `meshDoc.ts:174` refuses to persist when host ranges ≠ outliner parts, preserving the old doc rather than writing merged parts.
- **Live tracing left in**: `meshSetPartRanges` logs every push with a stack (`ModelView.tsx:586-587`, marked TEMPORARY / req_3056).
- **Alias chain**: same-count topology edits renumber group ids, so the mirror keeps a bounded alias map `partRangeAliasesRef` (`:1114`, 32-deep walk at `:1119`).
- **Cart-side boot source vs live native mesh** is explicitly a two-representation problem — `cart/editor/model/partResidency.ts:1-7`.

---

## 5. Persistence — what gets written and from where

Trigger points: `saveActiveModelNow` (`AppFrame.tsx:1415`, File→Save / first-atlas gate / close-switch), the autosave timer (`AppFrame.tsx:1494-1500`), and `autosaveActiveModelDoc` on doc switch (`AppFrame.tsx:5145-5167`). All funnel into `writeModelArtifacts` (`modelPackageStore.ts:667`).

| Artifact | Source | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `mesh/doc.blob` (RJMD v3) | `scene3d.modelDocumentSnapshot` | **live-buffer serialization** |
| `mesh/base.blob` | `scene3d.modelDocumentSnapshot` | **live-buffer serialization** |
| `mesh/painted.blob` + `painted.json` | `scene3d.paintedDocumentSnapshot` | **live-buffer serialization** |
| `mesh/collision.blob` | re-derived from `readMeshDoc(dir)` | **re-derivation from disk** |
| `atlases/base.png` | `__model_atlas_read` | live pixel readback |
| `atlases/raster-base.png` | `paint_program.baseline()` | live pixel baseline |
| `atlases/base.paint.json` | `__model_paint_program_read` | **stroke program (recipe), not pixels** |
| `atlases/layout.stale.json` | marker only | contract stamp |
| `mesh/parts.json` | JS outliner rows | metadata |

### Mesh blobs = live buffers, serialized
`hostModelMeshdocWrite` (`v8_bindings_core.zig:2072`) calls `scene3d.modelDocumentSnapshot(alloc)` (`3d.zig:3431` → `composeDocumentSnapshot`, `:3392`), which reads `model_source.verts()` (or `g_edit_verts` when `g_save_displayed_projection`) plus every `g_hidden_groups` block. Hidden parts are preserved: *"Visibility is presentation state: hidden triangles remain part of RJMD even though they are absent from the live draw mesh"* (`3d.zig:3429-3430`). Written atomically to `path.tmp.{ns}` → fsync → rename (`v8_bindings_core.zig:2118-2166`).

### Paint = stroke program, confirmed
`paint_program.zig:39-40`: *"a dither brush's scatter is the worst case for RLE and bloats a PNG, but it is generated by a few numbers — so we keep the numbers (the ops), never the scatter (the pixels)."*

`recordFill` at `3d.zig:7476` is annotated *"the stroke program is the durable form, not the atlas"*. The program is serialized with `MAGIC = 'RJPP'`, `VERSION: u16 = 5` (`paint_program.zig:70-71`) and stored base64 in `base.paint.json.program` (`modelPackageStore.ts:748-762`). Shader inks embed their own WGSL so the blob is self-contained (`paint_program.zig:41-42`).

**But it is program-over-raster, not program-alone.** v3/v4 records also persist `raster-base.png` — the exact atlas *underneath* the first stroke — so generated bases, part tints and externally edited PNGs survive replay (`paint_program.zig:5-7`, `:16-19`; write at `modelPackageStore.ts:743`). Hydration (`cart/editor/model/paintHydration.ts:60-80`) prefers: import raster base → apply exact corner UVs (v4) or island layout (v3) → replay program over it.

`atlases/base.png` is the *composite* readback, kept for placement rendering; `painted.blob` carries the paint-space UVs it maps onto (`v8_bindings_core.zig:2048-2053`, req_2833).

### The staleness gate
A topology op sets `g_paint_layout_stale` (`3d.zig:3919`, via `actionInvalidatesPaintLayout`, `mesh_journal_log.zig:218`). Save then writes geometry but drops the paint endorsement and writes `layout.stale.json` (`modelPackageStore.ts:686-703`); `readModelBasePaint` returns null while it exists (`:352`). Only an explicit *Remake Paint Atlas* clears it.

---

## 6. Hot reload vs full restart

`framework/state/hotstate.zig` is a `std.StringHashMap([]u8)` on the **page allocator** (`:15-18`), key→raw JSON. It is explicitly preserved across VM teardown: `v8_runtime.zig:211-213` — *"hotstate is explicitly preserved (that's the whole point of useHotState hydration after reload)."*

### Survives a hot reload (host process lives)
Everything Zig-side, because `resetForReload` (`3d.zig:9644`) deliberately does not touch it:
- `g_edit_verts` / `g_edit_key` / `g_edit_count` / `g_edit_revision`
- The whole journal: `g_journal_undo`, `g_journal_redo`, `g_journal_note`
- `mesh_edit` selection + weld topology; `g_mirror_mask`
- `model_paint` atlas `g_rgba`, layout, `g_layout_revision`; `paint_program` strokes/layers/baseline
- `model_source` source soup and part ranges; `g_hidden_groups`
- `g_orbit` camera
- The three twigs (`editor:meshdoc:v1`, `editor:meshtool:v1`, `editor:isopose:v1`)

The load-bearing comment (`3d.zig:9679-9689`):
> *"The mesh-editor SESSION survives the reload (req_2913 — this line was the bug that broke the req_2898 resume: `clearActiveEditMesh()` here wiped `g_edit_key` ...). The session's CPU copy (`g_edit_verts`, duped by `setPaintTarget`) is the durable truth: the GPU intern + the consumed stash copy died with the cache clears above, so RE-STASH it"*
```zig
3d.zig:9687-9689
    if (g_edit_key) |key| {
        if (g_edit_verts) |verts| _ = stashHostMesh(key, verts, g_edit_count);
    }
```

### Destroyed by a hot reload, rebuilt from the CPU copy
- GPU intern registry: `g_geo_cache_len = 0; g_retained_top = 0;` (`3d.zig:9645-9647`) — the buffer object is *not* freed, the bump cursor rewinds and the region is overwritten (`3d.zig:9640-9643`).
- `g_static_inst_cache` / `g_slim_static_cache` / `g_dyn_slots` (`:9648-9658`), ground D memos (`:9663-9665`), the host stash (`:9670-9673`), the texture-hash memo (`:9678`).
- The entire JS world: React state, refs, `partRangesRef`, `AppFrame` outliner rows — recovered by adopting the host session, not by copying state through JS (`docs/game/_index/records/editor_hot_reload.ts:43-48`).

### Destroyed only by a full app restart
`hotstate` is in-process, so a cold restart loses **all three twigs** → `resumeHostSession` returns false → the normal seed load runs (`ModelView.tsx:2367-2372`), which fires `meshEditBeginModel()` + `meshJournalClear()` + `orbitFrame()` (`v8_bindings_core.zig:330-350`, `:478-485`).

So exactly what a restart destroys that a reload does not:
- The undo/redo journal (`g_journal_undo/redo`, up to 192 MiB) and `g_journal_note`
- The live edit mesh + its re-key chain (`g_edit_verts`, `g_edit_key`, `g_edit_revision` resets to 0)
- The paint atlas raster, island layout, and the in-memory stroke program/layers/baseline (only the saved `base.paint.json` + `raster-base.png` come back)
- Host selection, weld topology, mirror mask, edit scope
- `g_hidden_groups` (hidden-part geometry stash — recoverable only because RJMD persists hidden faces)
- Orbit camera + camera bookmarks, tool/brush/palette state
- `g_geo_cache` slots orphaned by every previous re-key

---

## 7. GPU-side retained state

### Vertex geometry — one 256 MiB buffer, append-only, never evicts
`g_retained_vbuf` is created once at init (`3d.zig:8944-8950`), sized `(MAX_RETAINED_VERTS + DYN_REGION_VERTS) * @sizeOf(Vertex)` against `MAX_BUFFER_BYTES = 268_435_456` (`:277`).

`internGeometry` (`3d.zig:~370`) is a pure bump allocator:
```zig
    if (g_geo_cache_len >= GEO_CACHE_SIZE) return null;   // GEO_CACHE_SIZE = 2048
    if (g_retained_top + bytes > ...) return null;
    stageVertexRows(queue, buf, g_retained_top, verts, count);
    g_retained_top += bytes;
```
There is **no free path**. Consequence: every topology re-key appends a fresh slice and orphans the previous one. The only reclamation is `resetForReload` rewinding the cursor (`3d.zig:9645-9646`) or process exit. `3d.zig:9628-9638` documents the failure mode when the cursor/cache saturates (silent mesh drops).

- **Incremental in-place update:** yes, for position-only edits — `patchActiveEditMesh` (`3d.zig:715`) writes only faces `[first_face, last_face]` at the existing `e.offset_bytes` (`:743-749`).
- **Full re-upload:** only on first draw after a stash (`internFromStash`, `3d.zig:404`) — which is exactly what a hot reload forces.

### Paint atlas texture — persistent, dirty-band uploads
`g_paint_tex` (`3d.zig:9993`) is created once and **only recreated when the atlas dimensions change** (`3d.zig:10004`: `if (g_paint_tex == null or g_paint_tex_w != a.w or g_paint_tex_h != a.h)`). The header comment (`:9989-9992`) explains this is deliberate — a content-hash cache produced the delayed-apply bug.

Uploads:
```zig
3d.zig:10061-10070
    if (recreated) { lo = 0; hi = a.h - 1; upload = true; _ = model_paint.consumeDirtyRows(); }
    else if (model_paint.consumeDirtyRows()) |rows| { lo = rows[0]; hi = @min(rows[1], a.h - 1); upload = true; }
```
i.e. **one row band per frame**, not the whole texture (`model_paint.zig:81-87`, `g_dirty_lo`/`g_dirty_hi`/`g_has_dirty`). A topology op *does* force a texture recreate whenever `rebuildLayoutInner` picks a different atlas size — which is why `replaceActiveEditMeshPreservingAtlas` exists.

Other retained GPU state (`3d.zig:8712-8730`, `gpuMemoryStats` at `:313`): RT pool slots resized lazily, `g_tex_cache` is a content-hashed FIFO that self-evicts, static/slim instance pools are separate bump regions with their own cursors.

---

## Summary — where the design mutates in place vs rebuilds

The editor draws one hard line: **geometry that keeps its triangle identity is mutated in place; geometry that changes triangle identity is rebuilt and re-keyed.** A gizmo drag walks welded vertices → scatters positions into `model_paint.g_positions`, `g_edit_verts`, the indexed cache, the source soup through the displayed→source map, and finally `stageVertexRows` into the retained GPU buffer at the *same* offset — no allocation, no key change, one dirty face band. Any topology op instead funnels through `replaceActiveEditMesh`, which mints `modelview-edit-{hash}-{++revision}`, tears down and re-dupes every parallel array (`clearActiveEditMesh` → `setPaintTarget` → `model_source.retain` → `stashHostMesh`), resets the weld and the stroke program, and reallocates the paint atlas — with `replaceActiveEditMeshPreservingAtlas` as the softer variant that keeps the raster and its layout revision when the new soup can inherit the old UV coordinate space. Undo is deliberately *not* an inverse-op or journal-replay system for mesh: `JournalEntry` is a full deep snapshot of verts + groups + materials + part ranges + colors + hidden-part stashes (+ atlas pixels for texture ops), capped at 32 entries / 192 MiB, and undo is a swap-with-reinstall through the same rebuild path. Paint alone inverts this — the stroke program is the truth and paint undo re-runs the program over a persisted raster baseline, which is also exactly how it is stored on disk (`base.paint.json` + `raster-base.png`, never a flattened screenshot), while mesh blobs are straight serializations of the live in-memory buffers. The JS side holds no geometry at all; it mirrors only `{key, count, radius}`, part ranges, selection counts and outliner metadata, re-reading host truth after every adopt rather than patching, and it survives dev hot reload by *detecting* that the host still owns the document (doc twig key == `__model_session_json` key) and adopting it, because the only thing a hot reload actually destroys on the Zig side is the GPU intern cache — which `resetForReload` repopulates by re-stashing `g_edit_verts`. A full process restart is the only event that destroys the journal, atlas, selection, hidden-part stash and camera, since `hotstate` is an in-process map. The retained vertex buffer never evicts, so every re-key permanently orphans its predecessor's slot until the next reload or restart.</result>
